# iOS/iPadOS — 14 policies

All policies are named `[Baseline] - IOS - <D|U> - <Item>`; the tables below show the `<Item>` part.

| Folder | Count |
|---|---:|
| `SettingsCatalog/` | 8 |
| `DeviceConfigurations/` | 2 |
| `AppProtection/` | 1 |
| `CompliancePolicies/` | 3 |

## Device-scoped (D) — 10

Assign to device groups.

| Policy | What it does | Type | Settings | Assignment | checkId |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| [**Apple Intelligence Permitted**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Apple_Intelligence_Permitted.en.md) | Explicitly allows the generative Apple Intelligence features and the integration with external AI services on enrolled iPhones and iPads. | Settings Catalog | 12 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-183-IOSDAppleIntelligencePermitted` |
| [**Apple Intelligence Restricted**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Apple_Intelligence_Restricted.en.md) | Turns off the generative Apple Intelligence features on enrolled iPhones and iPads — Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground, Image Wand, personalised handwriting, summaries in Mail, Notes, Safari and Visual Intelligence — as well as the integration with external AI services such as ChatGPT. | Settings Catalog | 12 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-184-IOSDAppleIntelligenceRestricted` |
| [**Data Protection**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Data_Protection.en.md) | Keeps corporate data on every enrolled device separate from personal apps: documents from managed apps do not open in unmanaged apps, AirDrop counts as unmanaged, managed apps do not sync to iCloud, personal apps cannot read work contacts and local backups are encrypted. | Settings Catalog | 6 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-185-IOSDDataProtection` |
| [**Defender for Endpoint Onboarding Supervised**](DeviceConfigurations/Baseline_IOS_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_Onboarding_Supervised.en.md) | Onboards Microsoft Defender for Endpoint without user action on supervised corporate devices with a content filter profile, so that web protection works without a local VPN. | Device config | — | — | — |
| [**Defender for Endpoint Onboarding Unsupervised**](DeviceConfigurations/Baseline_IOS_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_Onboarding_Unsupervised.en.md) | Onboards Microsoft Defender for Endpoint without user action on unsupervised enrolled devices via Defender's local loopback VPN, which provides web protection without sending traffic off the device. | Device config | — | — | — |
| [**Enterprise SSO**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Enterprise_SSO.en.md) | Enables the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in of Microsoft Authenticator, so that managed apps and Safari share a single Entra sign-in and the device can prove itself to Conditional Access. | Settings Catalog | 19 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-188-IOSDEnterpriseSSO` |
| [**Lock Screen**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Lock_Screen.en.md) | Shows a message for the finder on the lock screen of a corporate iPhone or iPad, so that a lost device can be returned to the organisation. | Settings Catalog | 1 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-189-IOSDLockScreen` |
| [**Passcode**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Passcode.en.md) | Sets the passcode on enrolled iPhones and iPads that the compliance policy checks: at least six characters, no simple code, lock immediately, auto-lock after at most five minutes, and wipe only after ten failed attempts. | Settings Catalog | 6 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-190-IOSDPasscode` |
| [**Restrictions Corporate**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Restrictions_Corporate.en.md) | Hardening for supervised corporate iPhones and iPads: no manually installed profiles or developer apps, no apps from outside the App Store, untrusted TLS certificates automatically rejected, no erasing via Settings, a lock screen without Control Center, notification history, Today view and Siri, and Activation Lock only with a bypass code stored by Intune. | Settings Catalog | 18 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-191-IOSDRestrictionsCorporate` |
| [**Software Updates**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_IOS_D_Software_Updates.en.md) | Enforces the latest iOS version on enrolled iPhones and iPads no later than 14 days after release (installation at 02:00), locks automatic download and installation of OS and security updates to on, and prevents the user from rolling back security improvements. | Settings Catalog | 10 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-192-IOSDSoftwareUpdates` |

## User-scoped (U) — 4

Assign to user groups.

| Policy | What it does | Type | Settings | Assignment | checkId |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| [**App Protection**](AppProtection/Baseline_IOS_U_App_Protection.en.md) | Protects corporate data within the Microsoft apps on a personal iPhone or iPad: separate PIN, encryption, no copying to personal apps, and remote wipe of only the work data — without the device itself being managed. | App Protection | — | All Users | — |
| [**Compliance Defender for Endpoint**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_IOS_U_Compliance_Defender_for_Endpoint.en.md) | Marks an iPhone or iPad as non-compliant as soon as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint rates the machine risk higher than Medium. | Compliance | — | — | — |
| [**Compliance Device Health**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_IOS_U_Compliance_Device_Health.en.md) | Marks an iPhone or iPad that has been jailbroken as non-compliant. | Compliance | — | — | — |
| [**Compliance Password**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_IOS_U_Compliance_Password.en.md) | Checks whether an iPhone or iPad requires a passcode of at least six characters, no simple code, and locks after fifteen minutes. | Compliance | — | — | — |

---

**What it does** comes from `doel` in [`_manifest.json`](../_manifest.json) (translated). The same Dutch
sentence sits, together with the assignment target and the origin, in the template's `Description`
field — and so later in the tenant next to the policy.

An empty **checkId** means the platform engine has no matcher for that policy type
(Device config, compliance, app protection) — see the [main README](../../README.en.md#which-types-produce-a-check).
